comment: Book of Stray Minutes, page 6 of 12: gardens and seasons. Quill tends the Pendulum Garden, so the page warms him to the finder; a growing page grows a dreamseed.

reward.text: Every one of the Minutes of Growing Things is in its place now, and the page smells of turned earth and tomato leaves. Tucked in the fold, where a pressed flower might be, is a dreamseed; Quill would say it has only been waiting for the right hands.

collectibles.name: the bean-shoot minute
collectibles.text: the morning the beans came up all at once, like little green question marks

collectibles.name: the dandelion-clock minute
collectibles.text: a dandelion clock blown to pieces, and the hours counted as they floated off

collectibles.name: the pea-pod minute
collectibles.text: a pea pod split with a thumbnail, and every pea eaten before it reached the kitchen

collectibles.name: the windfall minute
collectibles.text: an apple dropping in the orchard with a soft thump, and nobody there to hear it but you

collectibles.name: the leaf-pile minute
collectibles.text: a jump into the pile of leaves someone had spent all afternoon raking

collectibles.name: the no-coat minute
collectibles.text: a spring day warm enough, at last, for no coat, with every face turned up like a flower

collectibles.name: the sunflower minute
collectibles.text: a measuring contest with a sunflower, which the sunflower won

collectibles.name: the digging minute
collectibles.text: a garden fork turning over dark soil, and a worm looking up, surprised

collectibles.name: the snowdrop minute
collectibles.text: the first snowdrop of the year, found by someone kneeling in the cold to be sure

collectibles.name: the tomato-leaf minute
collectibles.text: the green smell of tomato leaves on your fingers at the end of a long summer day

collectibles.name: the blackberry minute
collectibles.text: the best blackberry, just too far into the bramble, reached for anyway and won

collectibles.name: the seed-packet minute
collectibles.text: a paper packet shaken gently to hear whether the seeds inside were still awake

collectibles.name: the turning-leaf minute
collectibles.text: one leaf on the lane gone gold a whole week ahead of the others

collectibles.name: the cloud-watching minute
collectibles.text: a rabbit found in the clouds from flat on your back in the long grass, and then lost again
